	can_destroy = {

			location = {

				tv_wonder_mechanics_refresh_location_display_state_effect = yes
			}

			}
		}
	}

tv_wonder_sacred_mountain_ritual_annex = {
	is_special = yes
	is_foreign = no
	pop_type = clergy
	max_levels = 6
	employment_size = 0.1
	category = cultural_category

	town = yes
	city = yes
	megalopolis = yes
	rural_settlement = yes

	important_for_AI = no
	automation_build_allowed = no
	country_potential = { always = no }
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_WONDER_ENGINEERING_ONLY_BUILDING_TT
			always = no
		}
	}
	can_destroy = { always = yes }

	price = tv_wonder_ritual_annex_medium_price

	build_time = religious_building_time
	construction_demand = town_building_construction

	modifier = {
		local_clergy_desired_pop = 1
		local_clergy_estate_power = 0.5
	}

	possible_production_methods = {
		tv_wonder_module_maintenance
	}

	on_built = {
		hidden_effect = {
			location.owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = tv_wonder_ritual_in_progress
						var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 1
						var:tv_wonder_ceremony_style ?= 2
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ritual_auxiliary_building_finished value = 1 }
					tv_wonder_complete_active_ritual_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_construction_ended = {
		hidden_effect = {
			owner = {
				tv_wonder_mechanics_mark_completed_auxiliary_building_ritual_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

tv_wonder_giant_necropolis_ritual_annex = {
	is_special = yes
	is_foreign = no
	pop_type = nobles
	max_levels = 6
	employment_size = 0.1
	category = cultural_category

	town = yes
	city = yes
	megalopolis = yes
	rural_settlement = yes

	important_for_AI = no
	automation_build_allowed = no
	country_potential = { always = no }
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_WONDER_ENGINEERING_ONLY_BUILDING_TT
			always = no
		}
	}
	can_destroy = { always = yes }

	price = tv_wonder_ritual_annex_large_price

	build_time = large_cultural_building_time
	construction_demand = library_construction

	modifier = {
		local_unrest = -0.4
		local_nobles_estate_power = 0.5
	}

	possible_production_methods = {
		tv_wonder_module_maintenance
	}

	on_built = {
		hidden_effect = {
			location.owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = tv_wonder_ritual_in_progress
						var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 4
						var:tv_wonder_ceremony_style ?= 2
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ritual_auxiliary_building_finished value = 1 }
					tv_wonder_complete_active_ritual_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_construction_ended = {
		hidden_effect = {
			owner = {
				tv_wonder_mechanics_mark_completed_auxiliary_building_ritual_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

tv_wonder_giant_observatory_ritual_annex = {
	is_special = yes
	is_foreign = no
	pop_type = clergy
	max_levels = 6
	employment_size = 0.1
	category = cultural_category

	town = yes
	city = yes
	megalopolis = yes
	rural_settlement = yes

	important_for_AI = no
	automation_build_allowed = no
	country_potential = { always = no }
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_WONDER_ENGINEERING_ONLY_BUILDING_TT
			always = no
		}
	}
	can_destroy = { always = yes }

	price = tv_wonder_ritual_annex_large_price

	build_time = religious_building_time
	construction_demand = town_building_construction

	modifier = {
		local_raw_material_output = 0.2
		local_clergy_estate_power = 0.5
	}

	possible_production_methods = {
		tv_wonder_module_maintenance
	}

	on_built = {
		hidden_effect = {
			location.owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = tv_wonder_ritual_in_progress
						var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 8
						var:tv_wonder_ceremony_style ?= 2
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ritual_auxiliary_building_finished value = 1 }
					tv_wonder_complete_active_ritual_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_construction_ended = {
		hidden_effect = {
			owner = {
				tv_wonder_mechanics_mark_completed_auxiliary_building_ritual_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

	is_foreign = no

	max_levels = 6
	employment_size = 0.1
	category = cultural_category

	town = yes
	city = yes
	megalopolis = yes
	rural_settlement = yes

	important_for_AI = no
	automation_build_allowed = no
	country_potential = { always = no }
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_WONDER_ENGINEERING_ONLY_BUILDING_TT
			always = no
		}
	}
	can_destroy = { always = yes }

	price = tv_wonder_ritual_annex_medium_price

	build_time = religious_building_time
	construction_demand = town_building_construction

	modifier = {
		local_unrest = -0.2
		local_clergy_estate_power = 0.5
	}

	possible_production_methods = {
		tv_wonder_module_maintenance
	}

	on_built = {
		hidden_effect = {
			location.owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = tv_wonder_ritual_in_progress
						var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 11
						var:tv_wonder_ceremony_style ?= 2
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ritual_auxiliary_building_finished value = 1 }
					tv_wonder_complete_active_ritual_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_construction_ended = {
		hidden_effect = {
			owner = {
				tv_wonder_mechanics_mark_completed_auxiliary_building_ritual_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

tv_wonder_star_fortress_city_ritual_annex = {
	is_special = yes
	is_foreign = no
	pop_type = soldiers
	max_levels = 6
	employment_size = 0.1
	category = military_category

	town = yes
	city = yes
	megalopolis = yes
	rural_settlement = yes

	important_for_AI = no
	automation_build_allowed = no
	country_potential = { always = no }
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_WONDER_ENGINEERING_ONLY_BUILDING_TT
			always = no
		}
	}
	can_destroy = { always = yes }

	price = tv_wonder_ritual_annex_small_price

	build_time = small_fort_building
	construction_demand = fort_construction

	modifier = {
		local_crown_estate_power = 0.5
	}

	raw_modifier = {
		fort_level = 2
	}

	possible_production_methods = {
		tv_wonder_module_maintenance
	}

	on_built = {
		hidden_effect = {
			location.owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = tv_wonder_ritual_in_progress
						var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 15
						var:tv_wonder_ceremony_style ?= 2
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ritual_auxiliary_building_finished value = 1 }
					tv_wonder_complete_active_ritual_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_construction_ended = {
		hidden_effect = {
			owner = {
				tv_wonder_mechanics_mark_completed_auxiliary_building_ritual_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

tv_wonder_library_of_nation_ritual_annex = {
	is_special = yes
	is_foreign = no
	pop_type = clergy
	max_levels = 6
	employment_size = 0.1
	category = cultural_category

	town = yes
	city = yes
	megalopolis = yes
	rural_settlement = yes

	important_for_AI = no
	automation_build_allowed = no
	country_potential = { always = no }
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_WONDER_ENGINEERING_ONLY_BUILDING_TT
			always = no
		}
	}
	can_destroy = { always = yes }

	price = tv_wonder_ritual_annex_medium_price

	build_time = religious_building_time
	construction_demand = town_building_construction

	modifier = {
		local_max_literacy = 10
		local_clergy_estate_power = 0.5
	}

	possible_production_methods = {
		tv_wonder_module_maintenance
	}

	on_built = {
		hidden_effect = {
			location.owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = tv_wonder_ritual_in_progress
						var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 18
						var:tv_wonder_ceremony_style ?= 2
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ritual_auxiliary_building_finished value = 1 }
					tv_wonder_complete_active_ritual_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_construction_ended = {
		hidden_effect = {
			owner = {
				tv_wonder_mechanics_mark_completed_auxiliary_building_ritual_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

						var:tv_wonder_ceremony_style ?= 2
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ritual_auxiliary_building_finished value = 1 }
					tv_wonder_complete_active_ritual_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_construction_ended = {
		hidden_effect = {
			owner = {
				tv_wonder_mechanics_mark_completed_auxiliary_building_ritual_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

			always = no
		}
	}

	construction_demand = basic_construction_needs

		local_peasants_estate_power = 0.5
	}

		tv_wonder_module_maintenance
	}

	on_built = {

			location.owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = tv_wonder_ritual_in_progress
						var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 25
						var:tv_wonder_ceremony_style ?= 2
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ritual_auxiliary_building_finished value = 1 }
					tv_wonder_complete_active_ritual_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_construction_ended = {
		hidden_effect = {
			owner = {
				tv_wonder_mechanics_mark_completed_auxiliary_building_ritual_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

			location.owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = tv_wonder_ritual_in_progress
						var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 28
						var:tv_wonder_ceremony_style ?= 2
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ritual_auxiliary_building_finished value = 1 }
					tv_wonder_complete_active_ritual_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_construction_ended = {
		hidden_effect = {
			owner = {
				tv_wonder_mechanics_mark_completed_auxiliary_building_ritual_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

tv_wonder_worship_clock_bells = {
	is_special = yes
	is_foreign = no
	pop_type = clergy
	max_levels = 6
	employment_size = 0.1
	category = cultural_category

	town = yes
	city = yes
	megalopolis = yes
	rural_settlement = yes

	important_for_AI = no
	automation_build_allowed = no
	country_potential = { has_global_variable = tv_engineering_department_direct_build }
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_WONDER_DIRECT_BUILDING_ENABLED_TT
			has_global_variable = tv_engineering_department_direct_build
		}
	}
	can_destroy = {
		NOT = {
			owner ?= {
				var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 29
				var:tv_wonder_site ?= { this = root }
			}
		}
	}

	price = tv_wonder_direct_build_small_price

	build_time = huge_unique_build_time

	modifier = {
		local_cultural_tradition = 0.5
		local_cultural_influence = 0.5
		local_build_buildings_efficiency = 0.1
		monthly_towards_inward = 0.05
	}

	possible_production_methods = {
		tv_wonder_module_maintenance
	}

	on_built = {
		hidden_effect = {
			location = {
				tv_wonder_mechanics_sync_location_final_building_level_map_from_buildings_effect = yes
				tv_wonder_mechanics_refresh_location_display_state_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}

	on_destroyed = {
		hidden_effect = {
			location = {
				tv_wonder_great_clock_bell_system_handle_final_building_destroyed_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

tv_wonder_world_embassy_quarter_ritual_annex = {
	is_special = yes
	is_foreign = no
	pop_type = nobles
	max_levels = 6
	employment_size = 0.1
	category = government_category

	town = yes
	city = yes
	megalopolis = yes
	rural_settlement = yes

	important_for_AI = no
	automation_build_allowed = no
	country_potential = { always = no }
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_WONDER_ENGINEERING_ONLY_BUILDING_TT
			always = no
		}
	}
	can_destroy = { always = yes }

	price = tv_wonder_ritual_annex_medium_price

	build_time = government_build_time
	construction_demand = capital_building_construction

	modifier = {
		local_crown_estate_power = 1
		local_nobles_estate_power = 0.5
	}

	possible_production_methods = {
		tv_wonder_module_maintenance
	}

	on_built = {
		hidden_effect = {
			location.owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = tv_wonder_ritual_in_progress
						var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 32
						var:tv_wonder_ceremony_style ?= 2
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ritual_auxiliary_building_finished value = 1 }
					tv_wonder_complete_active_ritual_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_construction_ended = {
		hidden_effect = {
			owner = {
				tv_wonder_mechanics_mark_completed_auxiliary_building_ritual_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

	city = yes
	megalopolis = yes
	rural_settlement = yes

	important_for_AI = no
	automation_build_allowed = no
	country_potential = { always = no }
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_WONDER_ENGINEERING_ONLY_BUILDING_TT
			always = no
		}
	}
	can_destroy = { always = yes }

	price = tv_wonder_ritual_annex_small_price

	build_time = infrastructure_build_time
	construction_demand = basic_construction_needs

	modifier = {
		local_production_efficiency = 0.1
		local_burghers_estate_power = 0.5
	}

	possible_production_methods = {
		tv_wonder_module_maintenance
	}

	on_built = {
		hidden_effect = {
			location.owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = tv_wonder_ritual_in_progress
						var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 36
						var:tv_wonder_ceremony_style ?= 2
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ritual_auxiliary_building_finished value = 1 }
					tv_wonder_complete_active_ritual_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_construction_ended = {
		hidden_effect = {
			owner = {
				tv_wonder_mechanics_mark_completed_auxiliary_building_ritual_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

	is_special = yes
	is_foreign = no
	pop_type = nobles
	max_levels = 6
	employment_size = 0.1
	category = cultural_category

	town = yes
	city = yes
	megalopolis = yes
	rural_settlement = yes

	automation_build_allowed = no

	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_WONDER_DIRECT_BUILDING_ENABLED_TT
			has_global_variable = tv_engineering_department_direct_build
		}
	}
	can_destroy = {
		NOT = {
			owner ?= {
				var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 39
				var:tv_wonder_site ?= { this = root }
			}
		}
	}

	price = tv_wonder_direct_build_medium_price

	build_time = huge_unique_build_time

	modifier = {
		local_cultural_tradition = 0.5
		local_cultural_influence = 0.5
		local_unrest = -0.05
		cultures_capacity = 0.5
		monthly_towards_humanist = 0.05
	}

	possible_production_methods = {
		tv_wonder_module_maintenance
	}

	on_built = {
		hidden_effect = {
			location = {
				tv_wonder_mechanics_sync_location_final_building_level_map_from_buildings_effect = yes
				tv_wonder_mechanics_refresh_location_display_state_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}

	on_destroyed = {
		hidden_effect = {
			location = {

			}
		}
	}

tv_wonder_world_monument_group_ritual_annex = {
	is_special = yes
	is_foreign = no
	pop_type = nobles
	max_levels = 6
	employment_size = 0.1
	category = cultural_category

	town = yes
	city = yes
	megalopolis = yes
	rural_settlement = yes

	important_for_AI = no
	automation_build_allowed = no
	country_potential = { always = no }
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_WONDER_ENGINEERING_ONLY_BUILDING_TT
			always = no
		}
	}
	can_destroy = { always = yes }

	price = tv_wonder_ritual_annex_medium_price

	build_time = large_cultural_building_time
	construction_demand = library_construction

	modifier = {
		local_clergy_desired_pop = 1
		local_nobles_estate_power = 0.5
	}

	possible_production_methods = {
		tv_wonder_module_maintenance
	}

	on_built = {
		hidden_effect = {
			location.owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = tv_wonder_ritual_in_progress
						var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 39
						var:tv_wonder_ceremony_style ?= 2
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ritual_auxiliary_building_finished value = 1 }
					tv_wonder_complete_active_ritual_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_construction_ended = {
		hidden_effect = {
			owner = {
				tv_wonder_mechanics_mark_completed_auxiliary_building_ritual_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

	max_levels = 6
	employment_size = 0.1
	category = cultural_category

	town = yes
	city = yes
	megalopolis = yes
	rural_settlement = yes

	important_for_AI = no
	automation_build_allowed = no
	country_potential = { has_global_variable = tv_engineering_department_direct_build }
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_WONDER_DIRECT_BUILDING_ENABLED_TT
			has_global_variable = tv_engineering_department_direct_build
		}
	}
	can_destroy = {
		NOT = {
			owner ?= {
				var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 43
				var:tv_wonder_site ?= { this = root }
			}
		}
	}

	price = tv_wonder_direct_build_small_price

	build_time = huge_unique_build_time

	modifier = {
		local_cultural_tradition = 0.5
		local_cultural_influence = 0.5
		local_clergy_max_literacy = 10
		local_pop_conversion_speed = 0.005
		local_pop_conversion_speed_modifier = 0.2
		monthly_towards_communalism = 0.05
	}

	possible_production_methods = {
		tv_wonder_sacred_monument_maintenance
	}

	on_built = {
		hidden_effect = {
			location = {
				tv_wonder_mechanics_sync_location_final_building_level_map_from_buildings_effect = yes
				tv_wonder_mechanics_refresh_location_display_state_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}

	on_destroyed = {
		hidden_effect = {
			location = {
				tv_wonder_great_monastery_handle_final_building_destroyed_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

tv_wonder_great_monastery_ritual_annex = {
	is_special = yes
	is_foreign = no
	pop_type = clergy
	max_levels = 6
	employment_size = 0.1
	category = cultural_category

	town = yes
	city = yes
	megalopolis = yes
	rural_settlement = yes

	important_for_AI = no
	automation_build_allowed = no
	country_potential = { always = no }
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_WONDER_ENGINEERING_ONLY_BUILDING_TT
			always = no
		}
	}
	can_destroy = { always = yes }

	price = tv_wonder_ritual_annex_small_price

	build_time = religious_building_time
	construction_demand = town_building_construction

	modifier = {
		local_unrest = -0.1
		local_clergy_estate_power = 0.5
	}

	possible_production_methods = {
		tv_wonder_module_maintenance
	}

	on_built = {
		hidden_effect = {
			location.owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = tv_wonder_ritual_in_progress
						var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 43
						var:tv_wonder_ceremony_style ?= 2
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ritual_auxiliary_building_finished value = 1 }
					tv_wonder_complete_active_ritual_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_construction_ended = {
		hidden_effect = {
			owner = {
				tv_wonder_mechanics_mark_completed_auxiliary_building_ritual_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

		}
	}

		tv_wonder_module_maintenance

						has_variable = tv_wonder_ritual_in_progress

					}

				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_construction_ended = {
		hidden_effect = {
			owner = {
				tv_wonder_mechanics_mark_completed_auxiliary_building_ritual_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

			}
		}
	}
}

tv_wonder_mobile_fortress_ritual_annex = {
	is_special = yes
	is_foreign = no
	pop_type = soldiers
	max_levels = 6
	employment_size = 0.1
	category = military_category

	town = yes
	city = yes
	megalopolis = yes
	rural_settlement = yes

	important_for_AI = no
	automation_build_allowed = no
	country_potential = { always = no }
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_WONDER_ENGINEERING_ONLY_BUILDING_TT
			always = no
		}
	}
	can_destroy = { always = yes }

	price = tv_wonder_ritual_annex_small_price

	build_time = small_fort_building
	construction_demand = fort_construction

	modifier = {
		local_max_control = 0.1
		local_crown_estate_power = 0.5
	}

	possible_production_methods = {
		tv_wonder_module_maintenance
	}

	on_built = {
		hidden_effect = {
			location.owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = tv_wonder_ritual_in_progress
						var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 50
						var:tv_wonder_ceremony_style ?= 2
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ritual_auxiliary_building_finished value = 1 }
					tv_wonder_complete_active_ritual_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_construction_ended = {
		hidden_effect = {
			owner = {
				tv_wonder_mechanics_mark_completed_auxiliary_building_ritual_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

	town = yes

	megalopolis = yes
	rural_settlement = yes

	important_for_AI = no
	automation_build_allowed = no
	country_potential = { always = no }
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_WONDER_ENGINEERING_ONLY_BUILDING_TT
			always = no
		}
	}
	can_destroy = { always = yes }

	price = tv_wonder_ritual_annex_medium_price

	build_time = government_build_time
	construction_demand = capital_building_construction

	modifier = {
		local_market_access = 0.1
		local_trade_center_power = 0.1
		local_burghers_estate_power = 0.5
	}

	possible_production_methods = {
		tv_wonder_module_maintenance
	}

	on_built = {
		hidden_effect = {
			location.owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = tv_wonder_ritual_in_progress
						var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 53
						var:tv_wonder_ceremony_style ?= 2
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ritual_auxiliary_building_finished value = 1 }
					tv_wonder_complete_active_ritual_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_construction_ended = {
		hidden_effect = {
			owner = {
				tv_wonder_mechanics_mark_completed_auxiliary_building_ritual_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}
}
